team: Mercedes-AMG DTM Team ART (entered as EURONICS/BWT Mercedes-AMG)
car: Mercedes-AMG C 63 DTM (renamed C-Coupe DTM, old C204 body; new C205 body came 2016)
base_colors: royal blue upper body; yellow lower sweep; white sponsor panel
main_sponsor: EURONICS: white panel with blue letters and yellow stars on door, also on bonnet
other_sponsors: Petronas (sill, rear wing endplate), Bosch (windscreen), DEKRA/ADAC number panel on front fender, H&R, Sandtler, Hankook, 'best of electronics!' slogan on sill
layout_notes: Blue car; a yellow band sweeps from the rear bumper forward along the lower body to the front wheel arch; thin dark flow lines on the sill; rear wing black. Teammate Auer was completely different (pink BWT). Photo is a 2015 pre-season shot (location not stated).
photos: https://www.touringcartimes.com/app/uploads/2015/04/wpid-wp-1430206569410.jpeg (press photo, side view, not free) | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2_Gary_Paffett_(27860732656).jpg (CC BY-SA 2.0, but 2016 car with the 2016 version of the Euronics livery)

team: Mercedes-AMG DTM Team ART (entered as EURONICS/BWT Mercedes-AMG)
base_colors: light pink all over with printed water drops; blue logos; grey lower rear
main_sponsor: BWT: blue letters on bonnet and on door
other_sponsors: Petronas (rear wing, sill), Bosch (windscreen), Hankook, DEKRA/ADAC number panel; a name starting 'EURODA..' on roof edge (unsure)

main_sponsor: DEUTSCHE POST: post horn logo and name on bonnet, name and horn on door, name on roof strip above Bosch

layout_notes: All yellow; thin black pinstripe along waist line and lower sill; black diagonal BMW Motorsport band on bonnet; black splitter, sills and diffuser. Teammate Blomqvist white with M stripes. TCT says 2017 liveries were very similar to 2016; the 2016 and 2018 Commons photos show near identical yellow schemes.
